verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण परां व्रीडामुपागमत् ।शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसम्पन्नो मन्दं मन्दमुवाच ह ।। ७.६३.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa parāṁ vrīḍāmupāgamat ।śatrughno vīryasampanno mandaṁ mandamuvāca ha ।। 7.63.1 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rama, the valiant Shatrughna felt extreme embarrassment and spoke very slowly.
translations.hindi: जब महात्मा लक्ष्मण जी ने सूत से इस प्रकार आग्रह किआ तब वे ऋषिश्रेष्ठ के कहे हुए वचन, इस प्रकार सुनाने लगे

verses.sloka: अधर्मं विद्म काकुत्स्थ ह्यस्मिन्नर्थे नरेश्वर ।कथं तिष्ठत्सु ज्येष्ठेषु कनीयानभिषिच्यते ।। ७.६३.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: adharmaṁ vidma kākutstha hyasminnarthe nareśvara ।kathaṁ tiṣṭhatsu jyeṣṭheṣu kanīyānabhiṣicyate ।। 7.63.2 ॥

translations.english: O Kakutstha, O king, I indeed know that this matter is unrighteous; how can a younger brother be consecrated while his elders are present?
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! पूबेकाल में एक वार अत्नि के पुत्र दुर्वासा बरसात ऋतु के चार मास भर वसिष्ठ के पवित्र आश्रम में जाकर रहे

verses.sloka: अवश्यं करणीयं च शासनं पुरुषर्षभ ।तव चैव महाभाग शासनं दुरतिक्रमम् ।। ७.६३.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: avaśyaṁ karaṇīyaṁ ca śāsanaṁ puruṣarṣabha ।tava caiva mahābhāga śāsanaṁ duratikramam ।। 7.63.3 ॥

translations.english: O best among men and illustrious one, your command is certainly to be carried out and is indeed inviolable.

verses.sloka: त्वत्तो मया श्रुतं वीर श्रुतिभ्यश्च मया श्रुतम् ।नोत्तरं हि मया वाच्यं मध्यमे प्रतिजानति ।। ७.६३.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvatto mayā śrutaṁ vīra śrutibhyaśca mayā śrutam ।nottaraṁ hi mayā vācyaṁ madhyame pratijānati ।। 7.63.4 ॥

translations.english: O hero, I have heard from you and from the scriptures that when the middle brother undertakes a task, no reply should indeed be given by me.
translations.hindi: ॥ वहाँ जा कर उन्होंने देखा कि, बसिष्ठ जी की बाइ ओर, तेज से सूये की तरह चमचमाते, दुर्वा पा मुनि बैठे हुए हैं

verses.sloka: व्याहृतं दुर्वचो घोरं हन्तास्मि लवणं मृधे ।तस्यैवं मे दुरुक्तस्य दुर्गतिः पुरुषर्षभ ।। ७.६३.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: vyāhṛtaṁ durvaco ghoraṁ hantāsmi lavaṇaṁ mṛdhe ।tasyaivaṁ me duruktasya durgatiḥ puruṣarṣabha ।। 7.63.5 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, I have uttered terrible, harsh words, saying "I will kill Lavana in battle," and such an ill-spoken word of mine will lead to misfortune.

verses.sloka: उत्तरं नहि वक्तव्यं ज्येष्ठेनाभिहिते पुनः ।अधर्मसहितं चैव परलोकविवर्जितम् ।। ७.६३.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: uttaraṁ nahi vaktavyaṁ jyeṣṭhenābhihite punaḥ ।adharmasahitaṁ caiva paralokavivarjitam ।। 7.63.6 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, a reply should not be spoken again when commanded by the elder brother, as doing so is unrighteous and leads to no good in the afterlife.
translations.hindi: अध्य, फल, मूल, द्वारा सत्कारित हो, महाराज उन मुनियों के साथ बैठे

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं द्वितीयं काकुत्स्थ न वक्ष्यामि तवोत्तरम् ।मा द्वितीयेन दण्डो वै निपतेन्मयि मानद ।। ७.६३.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ dvitīyaṁ kākutstha na vakṣyāmi tavottaram ।mā dvitīyena daṇḍo vai nipatenmayi mānada ।। 7.63.7 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O scion of Kakutstha, I will not speak a second reply to you, lest a second punishment indeed fall upon me, O giver of honor.

verses.sloka: कामकारो ह्यहं राजंस्तवास्मि पुरुषर्षभ ।अधर्मं जहि काकुत्स्थ मत्कृते रघुनन्दन ।। ७.६३.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāmakāro hyahaṁ rājaṁstavāsmi puruṣarṣabha ।adharmaṁ jahi kākutstha matkṛte raghunandana ।। 7.63.8 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna tells Rama that he is at Rama's disposal and implores him to destroy this unrighteousness for his sake.
translations.hindi: उस समय किसी कथा के प्रसंग में महाराज ने हाथ जोड़ कर, उन अत्निपुत्र महात्मा तपोधन और सहाझानी दुवासा से कहा

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ते तु शूरेण शत्रुघ्नेन महात्मना ।उवाच रामः संहृष्टो भरतं लक्ष्मणं तथा ।। ७.६३.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukte tu śūreṇa śatrughnena mahātmanā ।uvāca rāmaḥ saṁhṛṣṭo bharataṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ tathā ।। 7.63.9 ॥

translations.english: When the brave and great-souled Shatrughna had thus spoken, Rama, greatly delighted, addressed Bharata and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: सम्भारानभिषेकस्य आनयध्वं समाहिताः ।अद्यैव पुरुषव्याघ्रमभिषेक्ष्यामि राघवम् ।। ७.६३.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: sambhārānabhiṣekasya ānayadhvaṁ samāhitāḥ ।adyaiva puruṣavyāghramabhiṣekṣyāmi rāghavam ।। 7.63.10 ॥

translations.english: Rama commanded them to carefully bring the materials for the consecration, declaring that he would anoint Bharata, the tiger among men and descendant of Raghu, today itself.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पुत्रों का कितना आयु होगा | हे भगवन्‌ ! मेरी बड़ी इच्छा है, आप मेरे बंश का वृत्तांत बणेन करें

verses.sloka: पुरोहितं च काकुत्स्थं नैगमानृत्विजस्तथा ।मन्त्रिणश्चैव तान्सर्वानानयध्वं ममाज्ञया ।। ७.६३.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: purohitaṁ ca kākutsthaṁ naigamānṛtvijastathā ।mantriṇaścaiva tānsarvānānayadhvaṁ mamājñayā ।। 7.63.11 ॥

translations.english: Rama further instructed them to bring the chief priest, the citizens, the ritual priests, and all the ministers by his command.

verses.sloka: राज्ञः शासनमाज्ञाय तथा ऽकुर्वन्महारथाः ।अभिषेकसमारम्भं पुरस्कृत्य पुरोधसम् ।प्रविष्टा राजभवनं राजानो ब्राह्मणास्तथा ।। ७.६३.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: rājñaḥ śāsanamājñāya tathā 'kurvanmahārathāḥ ।abhiṣekasamārambhaṁ puraskṛtya purodhasam ।praviṣṭā rājabhavanaṁ rājāno brāhmaṇāstathā ।। 7.63.12 ॥

translations.english: Having understood the king's command, the great charioteers (Bharata and Lakshmana) acted accordingly, and then the kings and Brahmins, honoring the chief priest, entered the royal palace for the commencement of the consecration.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! सुनिए पूवंकाल में देब्रताओं और दैत्यों का बड़ा भारी युद्ध हुआ था। तब दैत्य, देवताओं सं मार खा कर गु जी की पत्नी के शरण में गए | उस समय भूगुपरनी ने उनको अभयदान दिआ ओर उनको अपने यहाँ रख लिआ

verses.sloka: तथो ऽभिषेको ववृधे शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।सम्प्रहर्षकरः श्रीमान्राघवस्य पुरस्य च ।। ७.६३.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatho 'bhiṣeko vavṛdhe śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।sampraharṣakaraḥ śrīmānrāghavasya purasya ca ।। 7.63.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, the glorious anointing of the great-souled Shatrughna, which brought immense joy to Rama and the entire city, flourished.
translations.hindi: जब भगवान्‌ विष्णु ने देखा कि, भ्रगुपत्ती ने दैत्यों की रक्षा की हे, तब उन्होंने पैनी घार वाले सुटशेनचक्र से शगुपत्नी का _ मस्तक काट डाला

verses.sloka: अभिषिक्तस्तु शत्रुघ्नो बभौ चादित्यसन्निभः ।अभिषिक्तः पुरा स्कन्दः सेन्द्रैरिव मरुद्गणैः ।। ७.६३.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣiktastu śatrughno babhau cādityasannibhaḥ ।abhiṣiktaḥ purā skandaḥ sendrairiva marudgaṇaiḥ ।। 7.63.14 ॥

translations.english: Having been consecrated, Shatrughna shone like the sun, just as Skanda had shone in ancient times when consecrated by Indra and the Marut hosts.
translations.hindi: जब भ्रुण जी ने अपनी पत्नी को मरा हुआ देखा, तब इन कुलडउजागर ने शत्रु-कुल-संहार-कारी भगवान्‌ जनादन को शाप देते हुए कहा

verses.sloka: अभिषिक्ते तु शत्रुघ्ने रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ।पौराः प्रमुदिताश्चासन्ब्राह्मणाश्च बहुश्रुताः ।। ७.६३.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣikte tu śatrughne rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।paurāḥ pramuditāścāsanbrāhmaṇāśca bahuśrutāḥ ।। 7.63.15 ॥

translations.english: When Shatrughna was consecrated by Rama, whose deeds were effortless, the citizens and the highly learned Brahmins were greatly delighted.
translations.hindi: तूने मेरी अवध्या अर्थात्‌ निर्दोषी खरी का, क्रोध के वश में हो, वध किआ है; अतः हे जनादन ! तुमे मर्त्यलोक में अवदीणेँ होना पड़ेगा

verses.sloka: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च मङ्गलं केकयी तथा ।चक्रुस्ता राजभवने याश्चान्या राजयोषितः ।। ७.६३.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kausalyā ca sumitrā ca maṅgalaṁ kekayī tathā ।cakrustā rājabhavane yāścānyā rājayoṣitaḥ ।। 7.63.16 ॥

translations.english: Kausalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi, along with other royal ladies, performed auspicious rites in the royal palace.
translations.hindi: , हे मानद ! हे नृपश्रेष्ठ ! वे ही जनादन भगवानू इस लोक में आ, तुम्हारे पुत्र हुए हैं ओर इन्हीं का नाम श्री॥मचत्द्र तीनों: लोकों में ्रसिद्ध हुआ हे

verses.sloka: ऋषयश्च महात्मानो यमुनातीरवासिनः ।हतं लवणमाशंसुः शत्रुघ्नस्याभिषेचनात् ।। ७.६३.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahātmāno yamunātīravāsinaḥ ।hataṁ lavaṇamāśaṁsuḥ śatrughnasyābhiṣecanāt ।। 7.63.17 ॥

translations.english: The great-souled sages dwelling on the banks of the Yamuna predicted that Lavana would be slain as a result of Shatrughna's consecration.
translations.hindi: फिर शापप्रदान के भय से पीड़ित हो, भगु जी उनका बड़ी अक्ति से पूजन करने लगे। कुछ काल बाद श्रगु जी के तप से असन्न हो भक्तवत्सल भगवान्‌ जनादन उनसे बोले

verses.sloka: ततो ऽभिषिक्तं शत्रुघ्नमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः ।उवाच मधुरां वाणीं तेजस्तस्याभिपूरयन् ।। ७.६३.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhiṣiktaṁ śatrughnamaṅkamāropya rāghavaḥ ।uvāca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ tejastasyābhipūrayan ।। 7.63.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, Rama, having placed the consecrated Shatrughna on his lap, spoke sweet words, thereby enhancing his splendor and might.

verses.sloka: अयं शरस्त्वमोघस्ते दिव्यः परपुरञ्जयः ।अनेन लवणं सौम्य हन्ता ऽसि रघुनन्दन ।। ७.६३.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ śarastvamoghaste divyaḥ parapurañjayaḥ ।anena lavaṇaṁ saumya hantā 'si raghunandana ।। 7.63.19 ॥

translations.english: O gentle Shatrughna, this divine arrow of yours is unfailing and capable of conquering enemy cities; with this, you will surely kill Lavana.

verses.sloka: सृष्टः शरो ऽयं काकुत्स्थ यदा शेते महार्णवे ।। ७.६३.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭaḥ śaro 'yaṁ kākutstha yadā śete mahārṇave ।। 7.63.20 ॥

translations.english: O Kakutstha, this arrow was created when (Vishnu) rested in the great cosmic ocean.
translations.hindi: तत्‌ फल प्राप्स्यते चापि भृगुशापक्रतं महत्‌ । = 6 है अथोध्यायाः पती रामो दीघकालं भविष्यति

verses.sloka: स्वयम्भूरजितो देवो यन्नापश्यन्सुरासुराः ।अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां तेनायं तु शरोत्तमः ।। ७.६३.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: svayambhūrajito devo yannāpaśyansurāsurāḥ ।adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ tenāyaṁ tu śarottamaḥ ।। 7.63.21 ॥

translations.english: This arrow is indeed the best of arrows because it was created by the self-born, unconquered God (Vishnu) in a form that was invisible to all gods, demons, and other beings.
translations.hindi: उनके अनुगामी जन सुखी और धनधान्य से भरे पूरे होंगे । वे ग्यारह हजार वर्षा तक राज्य कर, ब्रह्मलोक में चले जाँयगे । वे बढी बढ़ी दक्षिणाओं वाले अश्वमेधादि यज्ञ करेंगे | उनको कोई जीत न सकेगा

verses.sloka: सृष्टः क्रोधाभिभूतेन विनाशार्थं दुरात्मनोः ।मधुकैटभयोर्वीर विघाते वर्तमानयोः ।स्रष्टुकामेन लोकांस्त्रींस्तौ चानेन हतौ युधि ।। ७.६३.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭaḥ krodhābhibhūtena vināśārthaṁ durātmanoḥ ।madhukaiṭabhayorvīra vighāte vartamānayoḥ ।sraṣṭukāmena lokāṁstrīṁstau cānena hatau yudhi ।। 7.63.22 ॥

translations.english: O hero, this arrow was created by the angry (Vishnu) for the destruction of the two wicked demons, Madhu and Kaitabha, who were obstructing the creation of the three worlds, and indeed, those two were killed in battle by this very arrow.

verses.sloka: तौ हत्वा जनभोगार्थं कैटभं तु मधुं तथा ।अनेन शरमुख्येन ततो लोकांश्चकार सः ।। ७.६३.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tau hatvā janabhogārthaṁ kaiṭabhaṁ tu madhuṁ tathā ।anena śaramukhyena tato lokāṁścakāra saḥ ।। 7.63.23 ॥

translations.english: Having killed Kaitabha and Madhu for the benefit of mankind, he (Vishnu) then created the worlds with this excellent arrow.
translations.hindi: वे कई बार अनेक राजवंशों की स्थापना करेंगे । उनसे सीता के दो पुत्र होंगे

verses.sloka: नायं मया शरः पूर्वं रावणस्य वधार्थिना ।मुक्तः शत्रुघ्न भूतानां महांस्त्रासो भवेदिति ।। ७.६३.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāyaṁ mayā śaraḥ pūrvaṁ rāvaṇasya vadhārthinā ।muktaḥ śatrughna bhūtānāṁ mahāṁstrāso bhavediti ।। 7.63.24 ॥

translations.english: O Shatrughna, I did not release this arrow previously, even when desiring Ravana's death, thinking that it would cause great terror to all beings.
translations.hindi: हे लद्दमण ! इस प्रकार तुम्हारे वंश का भावी फल कह कर यह महातेजस्वी दुवासा मुनि चुप हो गए

verses.sloka: यच्च तस्य महच्छूलं त्र्यम्बकेण महात्मना ।दत्तं शत्रुविनाशाय मधोरायुधमुत्तमम् ।। ७.६३.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yacca tasya mahacchūlaṁ tryambakeṇa mahātmanā ।dattaṁ śatruvināśāya madhorāyudhamuttamam ।। 7.63.25 ॥

translations.english: And that great trident, Madhu's excellent weapon, was given to him by the great-souled Tryambaka (Shiva) for the destruction of enemies.

verses.sloka: स तं निक्षिप्य भवने पूज्यमान पुनः पुनः ।दिशः सर्वाः समासाद्य प्राप्नोत्याहारमुत्तमम् ।। ७.६३.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ nikṣipya bhavane pūjyamāna punaḥ punaḥ ।diśaḥ sarvāḥ samāsādya prāpnotyāhāramuttamam ।। 7.63.26 ॥

translations.english: Having placed that (trident) in his dwelling, and being worshipped repeatedly, he (Madhu) would traverse all directions and obtain excellent food.
translations.hindi: उस समय मुनिराज के मुख से ये सब बातें मेंने सुनी थीं आर तब से इनको अपने हृदय में रखे हुए था। सो उनकी वह अविष्यद्वाणो अन्यथा नहीं हो सकती

verses.sloka: यदा तु युद्धमाकाङ्क्षन् कश्चिदेनं समाह्वयेत् ।तदा शूलं गहीत्वा तं भस्म रक्षः करोति हि ।। ७.६३.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā tu yuddhamākāṅkṣan kaścidenaṁ samāhvayet ।tadā śūlaṁ gahītvā taṁ bhasma rakṣaḥ karoti hi ।। 7.63.27 ॥

translations.english: But when someone desiring battle would challenge him, the demon (Madhu) would then take the trident and indeed reduce that challenger to ashes.

verses.sloka: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल तमायुधविनाकृतम् ।अप्रविष्टं पुरं पूर्वं द्वारि तिष्ठ धृतायुधः ।। ७.६३.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla tamāyudhavinākṛtam ।apraviṣṭaṁ puraṁ pūrvaṁ dvāri tiṣṭha dhṛtāyudhaḥ ।। 7.63.28 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, you should stand at the city gate, armed, and wait for him, who is deprived of weapons and has not yet entered the city.
translations.hindi: हे नरोत्तम ! “अतः तुम श्रोरामचन्द्र अथवा सीना के लिए दुःखी मत हो और अपना मन दृढ़ कर लो। क्योंकि होनहार हुए बिना नहीं रहेगी

verses.sloka: अप्रविष्टं च भवनं युद्धाय पुरुषर्षभ ।आह्वयेथा महाबाहो ततो हन्तासि राक्षसम् ।। ७.६३.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: apraviṣṭaṁ ca bhavanaṁ yuddhāya puruṣarṣabha ।āhvayethā mahābāho tato hantāsi rākṣasam ।। 7.63.29 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, O mighty-armed one, you should challenge him for battle before he enters his dwelling, and then you will be able to kill the demon.

verses.sloka: अन्यथा क्रियमाणे तु अवध्यः स भविष्यति ।यदि त्वेवं कृते वीर विनाशमुपयास्यति ।। ७.६३.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: anyathā kriyamāṇe tu avadhyaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ।yadi tvevaṁ kṛte vīra vināśamupayāsyati ।। 7.63.30 ॥

translations.english: If this is done otherwise, he will become unkillable, but if you act in this manner, O hero, he will certainly meet his destruction.

verses.sloka: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं शूलस्य च विपर्ययः ।श्रीमतः शितिकण्ठस्य कृत्यं हि दुरतिक्रमम् ।। ७.६३.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ śūlasya ca viparyayaḥ ।śrīmataḥ śitikaṇṭhasya kṛtyaṁ hi duratikramam ।। 7.63.31 ।।

translations.english: All this has been explained to you, including the reversal of the spear's power, for the deed of the glorious blue-throated Shiva is indeed impossible to transgress. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 63 ।। Thus ends the sixty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
